defaultTimeoutMs.description: Default command execution timeout in milliseconds. The per-call `timeout` tool parameter overrides this.

promptTimeoutMs.description: Auto-cancel the password prompt after this many milliseconds without an answer, so a blocked agent does not wait forever. 0 waits indefinitely.

cacheTtlMs.description: How long a cached sudo password stays valid, in milliseconds. 0 disables time-based expiry (turns and manual /sudo-forget still apply).

cacheTurns.description: How many completed agent turns a cached sudo password stays valid for. 0 means unlimited turns.

maxPromptAttempts.description: Password prompt attempts before the tool gives up after repeated wrong passwords.
